privileged_info_for_vlm: Verified values for assessment: 1. Benzene: PEL=1ppm, Odor=~60ppm (INADEQUATE). 2. Hydrogen Sulfide: PEL=20ppm, Odor=~1ppm (ADEQUATE). 3. Toluene: PEL=200ppm, Odor=~1.6-2.1ppm (ADEQUATE). 4. Carbon Monoxide: PEL=50ppm, Odor=Odorless/NA (NO_WARNING). 5. Dichloromethane: PEL=25ppm, Odor=~160-250ppm (INADEQUATE). Note: If a range is given for odor, the agent must use the lower value. Assessment logic: Odor < PEL = ADEQUATE; Odor >= PEL = INADEQUATE; Odorless = NO_WARNING.
